summary: Ran a frontend-only retest of the mobile hamburger drawer bug, using Playwright device emulation (isMobile, hasTouch, Pixel 7 at 393x851 DPR2 and iPhone 13 at 390x844 DPR3). THE BUG IS NOT FIXED. On all 5 pages tested (pagamento-pix, inscricao-realizada, inscricao, dados-inscricao, confirmacao) #mnav opens but is only 56.8px tall instead of 844-851px. None of the 6 items or the 2 CTA buttons can be clicked (elementFromPoint misses them). The fix shipped in seduc-theme.js v19 is correctly applied (host overflow:visible, display:flow-root), but it does not address the real cause. ROOT CAUSE: line 20 of /app/frontend/public/cebraspe/chrome.css has '@media screen and (-webkit-min-device-pixel-ratio:1.25),(min-resolution:120dpi){.sfbody{transform:scale(0.8);transform-origin:top left;width:125%;height:125%}}'. Every real phone has DPR of 2 or more, so .sfbody gets a transform. A transformed element becomes the containing block for position:fixed descendants. So #mnav (top:0;bottom:0) is sized to the 71px .sfbody (71*0.8 = 56.8px), and #mnav-backdrop is clipped the same way. That is why the backdrop click does not close the menu. This also explains why the bug cannot be reproduced at DPR=1: the screenshot tool and desktop browsers there give a full-height drawer of 844px. minhas-inscricoes.html has the same broken drawer at DPR3, plus horizontal overflow. Proven in-page: injecting '.sfbody{transform:none!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important}' under max-width:1000px gives a full-height 844px drawer at DPR3. The X close button works. Desktop at 1920 is fine on all 6 pages: header host 201px, horizontal menu visible, burger hidden, no horizontal scroll. Mobile header host height is 71px on all pages.

ui_bugs.issue: On HiDPI mobile (DPR>=1.25, which means every real phone) the drawer is only 56.8px tall and the items and CTAs are not visible or clickable. Caused by transform:scale(0.8) on .sfbody (chrome.css line 20), which makes .sfbody the containing block for position:fixed. Affects inscricao, dados-inscricao, confirmacao, pagamento-pix, inscricao-realizada, minhas-inscricoes. The v19 overflow fix has no effect.
#mnav-backdrop (fixed inset:0) is also confined to the transformed .sfbody, so tapping the dark area outside the header does not close the menu at DPR>=1.25. The X close button works.

At 390px DPR3 emulation the layout viewport grows to innerWidth=658 and scrollWidth=662, so the page has horizontal overflow and is zoomed out. At DPR1 it is fine (393). Likely the width:125% from the same DPR media query on the footer or header .sfbody.

action_items: Fix the real cause in /app/frontend/public/cebraspe/chrome.css. Option A: inside the mobile media query (max-width:1000px), neutralise the DPR scale with '.sfbody{transform:none!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important}'. Verified that this gives a full-height drawer. Then re-check header and logo sizing on mobile, since it is no longer scaled by 0.8.

Option B: keep the scale but move #mnav and #mnav-backdrop out of .sfbody, so they are direct children of the shadow root. Toggle the 'mnav-on' class on a non-transformed wrapper or on the host, and adjust the CSS selectors '.sfbody.mnav-on #mnav'.
Bump the chrome.css cache version (V='18' in seduc-theme.js is used for chrome.css and parts.json) so phones fetch the new CSS.
Test with deviceScaleFactor>=2 (e.g. Playwright device emulation). At DPR=1 the bug does not appear.
Investigate the horizontal overflow on minhas-inscricoes.html at DPR3 (innerWidth 658).
critical_code_review_comments: seduc-theme.js lines 40-41: the overflow:visible and display:flow-root workaround targets the wrong cause. An overflow:hidden ancestor does not clip position:fixed descendants; transform, filter and contain do. It is harmless, but it can be removed once the real fix is in.
chrome.css line 20: the global DPR-based transform:scale(0.8) with width/height 125% is a fragile legacy hack. It breaks fixed positioning and causes layout overflow on HiDPI devices.

success_rate.frontend: 20% (desktop regression and X close pass; the drawer full height, item clickability and backdrop close fail at DPR>=2 on all pages)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use browser.new_context(viewport=390x844, device_scale_factor=3, is_mobile=True, has_touch=True) through page.context.browser in the browser tool. Check document.getElementById('seduc-header-host').shadowRoot.getElementById('mnav').getBoundingClientRect().height == innerHeight after clicking #mnav-open. Also check that the computed transform of .sfbody is 'none' on mobile, or that #mnav is not inside it.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: emulate a phone with DPR 2 or 3, open /pagamento-pix.html and tap the burger. #mnav is 56.8px tall. Cause: the chrome.css media query (-webkit-min-device-pixel-ratio:1.25) sets .sfbody{transform:scale(0.8)}. Per the CSS spec, a transformed ancestor is the containing block for fixed descendants, so #mnav (top:0;bottom:0) takes the .sfbody height of 71px * 0.8. Mitigation: remove the transform on mobile, or move the drawer and backdrop outside the transformed element.
